candidates.text: When a process dies after promote_artifact wrote a canonical artifact but before write_checkpoint recorded that phase, the resumed process must halt on the resulting canonical-path collision rather than overwrite it; a user-authorized rename that preserves the uncounted artifact's content (with its SHA-256 and reason logged in an operator-actions record) is a sufficient, evidence-preserving way to clear the collision so a fresh restarted-phase dispatch can promote its own artifact.

record_memory_applied refuses an evidence_path whose content does not literally contain the applied entry_id, so a decision that is only visible as an ordinary request file (e.g. a V-2 command id chosen because of a lesson) must first be retained as a policy event that names the memory entry id, and the memory_applied record then points at policy-events.jsonl.
